0.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_000
0.description: Everyone seems so busy. Yet here I am, twiddling my fins. As much as I despise manual labor, boredom somehow seems crueler. <sigh> Would that I had something fun to do...

1.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_001
1.description: As the most discerning of the Namazu, I have been tasked with overseeing the paissa competition! Notice the smoldering intensity of my stare as I shrewdly appraise you. But do not be alarmed! I am friendlier than I look, yes, yes.

2.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_100_001
2.description: Come to see the paissas, yes, yes? I'm afraid it would be terribly dull at present. Perhaps if we can find something to raise their spirits.

3.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_002
3.description: Thank you again for your help. The paissas are sure to be excited when they see what you've brought. Yes, yes.

4.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_003
4.description: Tell Seigetsu that all will be well. For now, at least. And when you are finished, I would be more than happy to show you the paissas! While taking the proper safety precautions, yes, yes.

5.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_010
5.description: The paissas seem to be in high spirits today, yes, yes. They might even be up for a match! Care to see for yourself?

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_015
9.description: You're in for a treat, my friend.

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_016
10.description: Though it may be best if we find a location removed from Dhoro Iloh. Yes, yes. I fear the paissas will wreak indiscriminate destruction once they get to tussling, smashing our parade floats and ripping our pavilions to ribbons! But come, come. I know just the place to unleash them safely.

11.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_020
11.description: Here we are. The perfect venue to show off what the paissa can do. Is it not impressive? I detected it from afar with my keen gaze. Yes, yes.

12.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_021
12.description: Naturally, I will serve as referee. Naught will escape my all-seeing eyes, no, no. Unless I blink. Which I never do.

13.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_022
13.description: ...Ahem. Merely watching them come to blows wouldn't be very interesting, though, would it? Care to wager which will emerge the victor?

14.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_023
14.description: That said, this is only an exhibition match. Do not hesitate for fear of choosing wrong─I certainly do not expect everyone to share my skill at spotting the to-be victor!

15.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_Q2_000_000
15.description: Which paissa do you believe will emerge victorious?

18.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_024
18.description: An excellent choice. Yes, yes. Make sure not to lose track of who's who once their fists and fur start flying.

20.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_030
20.description: What!? I-I'm not your opponent. Stay back! Back, I say!

21.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_031
21.description: Wait! Stop, stop! Where are you going? There can be no exhibition without our competitors. Come back here and unleash your fury this instant!

22.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_032
22.description: You'll help me bring them back. Yes, yes?

23.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_033
23.description: By the Big One! How did they escape their pen!?

24.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_034
24.description: Quickly. We have to get them back to Dhoro Iloh, before they tear each other to shreds!

25.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_035
25.description: <gasp> Can you feel that? The tension between them is palpable. You may want to stand back. Their fury can be like a typhoon, savage and unpredictable. I would hate for you to be caught between them.

26.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_036
26.description: I realize how terrifying this must be, but you cannot look away. No matter how deeply this gruesome scene will scar your mind forevermore, you must watch. Yes, yes.

27.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_040
27.description: Let's try this again. Yes, yes. Ready... Begin!

28.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_041
28.description: Have you ever seen such a display of martial prowess? The Ok'Gundu Gladiator nearly delivered a killing blow, but the Rosehouse Wrestler, at the very last moment, sidestepped the punch and delivered a staggering roundhouse in return! A shame no one else was here to witness this.

29.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_042
29.description: Have you ever seen such carnage? If not for the Rosehouse Wrestler's thick fur, the Ok'Gundu Gladiator would surely have rent the flesh from his bones. Why, the poor beast is so disoriented, he's lost all sense of direction. Unprecedented!

30.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_043
30.description: The battle has grown so intense I can scarcely stand it! A ceaseless flurry of punches and kicks from both sides, and yet they remain unscathed. Now, they close in for the kill.

31.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_044
31.description: Never have I seen such displays of brutality. To be frank, I don't know what's gotten into them. I only pray they both survive to participate in the actual competition.

32.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_045
32.description: Would you look at that footwork! They seem to float as they circle about one another. It's a wonder either of them can land a blow at all.

33.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_050
33.description: This looks to be a turning point in the match, the outcome of which may very well depend on your support. Yes, yes.

34.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_Q3_000_000
34.description: How will you cheer on your chosen paissa?

38.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_060
38.description: And...the match is over! Coming all the way from the Sea of Clouds, he's battered and abused, but fluffy and furious! Today's champion is...the Rosehouse Wrestler!

39.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_061
39.description: And...the match is over! Coming all the way from the Sea of Clouds. He's lithe and lean with fists of nightsteel! Today's champion is...the Ok'Gundu Gladiator!

40.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_062
40.description: I cannot allow this bloodletting to proceed any further. After all, this was only meant to be a demonstration. Yes, yes. I hereby declare this match a draw!

41.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_063
41.description: As referee my word is final. My word is law. Those who would oppose my decision, well... That's too bad.

42.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_070
42.description: You chose the Rosehouse Wrestler at the start, did you not? Congratulations! It seems you have an eye for talent. Though not as good as mine.

43.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_071
43.description: It was a close match. Yes, yes. The Rosehouse Wrestler put up a good fight, but sadly today was not meant to be his day.

44.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_072
44.description: You chose the Ok'Gundu Gladiator at the start, did you not? Congratulations! It seems you have an eye for talent. Though not as good as mine.

45.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_073
45.description: It was a close match. Yes, yes. The Ok'Gundu Gladiator put up a good fight, but sadly today was not meant to be his day.

46.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_074
46.description: My apologies, friend. If I had let them continue, I'm quite certain only we would be returning to Dhoro Iloh this day.

47.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_080
47.description: So, what did you think? Did it set your whiskers to tingling? Ah, of course not. You have no whiskers. Still, I hope you enjoyed this little exhibition all the same.

48.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_081
48.description: Now, let us return to Dhoro Iloh. They need time for their wounds and minds to recover from the trauma of today's match.

49.name: TEXT_REGOTH3GYOKA_00482_GYOKA_000_090
49.description: Of course, I understand. A fight between paissas is not for the squeamish. No, no. If you should change your mind, however, you are welcome to see them any time.
